'''Blains Vorlin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] who served as the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].

==Biography==
Vorlin served alongside [[Davim Cross]] in the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Diplomatic Corps]] before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. He also knew his [[Jahan Cross's mother|wife]].<ref name="AotE-IE,P1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref>

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he sent his aide [[Emesh Nar]] to meet [[Jahan Cross]] at [[Mondder Spaceport]] and invite him to a party at the [[Imperial Embassy (Etti IV)|embassy]].<ref name="AotE-IE,P1" /> At the party, he greeted Cross and told him to enjoy himself.<ref name="AotE:IE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]]</ref>
